mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast_location_code_sequence (tenant_id, code_namespace, next_value) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{namespace}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_value = next_value
mapper.select: SELECT next_value FROM ast_location_code_sequence WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code_namespace = #{namespace} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_location_code_sequence SET next_value = next_value + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code_namespace = #{namespace}
